overall_summary: Analysis of 36 deduplicated uploads confirms that extreme planetary science paired with first-person experiential 'What If You Fell Into...' hooks dominates engagement and velocity. Recent top performers like 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (980 views in 3 days) and 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet' (1,024 views, 38 likes) vastly outperform repetitive psychology trivia and generic facts, which struggle to surpass 100 views.

winning_patterns.pattern: First-Person Survival / 'What If You Fell Into...' Extreme Exoplanets
winning_patterns.evidence: 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet' generated 1,024 views and 38 likes; 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice' reached 972 views. Viewers show strong retention for sensory descriptions of impossible celestial physics.
winning_patterns.action: Pair extreme astronomical anomalies with direct second-person POV stakes ('What happens to your body if you drop into...') rather than detached encyclopedic narration.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' secured 980 views within 3 days (highest recent velocity), and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' generated 1,027 views with 36 likes.
winning_patterns.action: Lead with a punchy, counter-intuitive metric hook in the first 1.5 seconds, then unpack the planetary mechanics.

weak_patterns.evidence: Repeated uploads of identical or near-identical concepts ('Why Space Is Completely Silent' scored 33-87 views; 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' flatlined at 5-10 views across multiple tries).
weak_patterns.action: Cease verbatim re-uploads of unengaged concepts. YouTube algorithms suppress duplicate metadata when audience testing fails repeatedly.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' (17 views), 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' (38 views), and 'AI Recreates Pink Floyd Song' (89 views) showed near-zero virality.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract psychology and minor brain trivia unless framed as high-stakes evolutionary horror or sensory illusion.
